{'text': '亞馬遜秋季Prime Day大減價現已正式開始，AirPods Pro 3及AirPods Max 2推出歷來最優惠折扣，M6 Mac mini更首次見到低至150美元減價，而2026年Apple Watch優惠亦全面啟動。多款Apple Watch Series 12配置已跌至歷史新低，全新Apple Watch Ultra 4更有近100美元減幅。全部優惠詳見下文。', 'en': "Amazon's fall Prime Day sale is now officially live with the best discounts yet on AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2, the first discount to $150 on M6 Mac mini, and all the 2026 Apple Watch deals live. Multiple Apple Watch Series 12 configurations have dropped to all-time lows, and the new Apple Watch Ultra 4 is nearly $100 off. All the deals below."}

{'text': '全新Apple Watch Series 12最近正式登場，帶來全新Dark Brass（暗銅）處理及多款新錶帶配色，而亞馬遜秋季Prime Day大減價現正提供有史以來最低價格。', 'en': "The all-new Apple Watch Series 12 just launched recently with a new Dark Brass finish and several new band colors, and Amazon's fall Prime Day sale now has the lowest prices ever."}

{'text': '多個配置現以新低價發售，減幅近50美元，包括標準GPS型號、GPS + 流動網絡版本，以及配搭靚絕Dark Bronze（古銅）米蘭尼斯錶帶的46mm古銅色型號，後者正是我的心水選擇。', 'en': 'Multiple configurations are now on sale at new lows with nearly $50 off, including the standard GPS model, the GPS + cellular model, and the 46mm bronze model with the gorgeous Dark Bronze Milanese Loop, which is my personal favorite.'}

  • {'text': '42mm Apple Watch Series 12 350美元（原價399美元）', 'en': '42mm Apple Watch Series 12 $350 ($399)'}
  • {'text': '46mm Apple Watch Series 12 400美元（原價450美元）', 'en': '46mm Apple Watch Series 12 $400 ($450)'}
  • {'text': '42mm Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + 流動網絡 450美元（原價500美元）', 'en': '42mm Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular $450 ($500)'}
  • {'text': '46mm Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + 流動網絡 500美元（原價550美元）', 'en': '46mm Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular $500 ($550)'}

{'text': '應否升級至Apple Watch Series 12？可參閱9to5Mac完整評測助你決定。', 'en': "Should you upgrade to Apple Watch Series 12? See 9to5Mac's full review to help you decide."}

{'text': '雖然全新Apple Watch Ultra 4的秋季Prime Day優惠至今供貨不太穩定，但多個配置正反覆上架補貨，售價為歷來最低——無論是標準配置抑或配搭米蘭尼斯錶帶的高階版本，現時均有近100美元減幅。', 'en': 'While the fall Prime Day deals on the all-new Apple Watch Ultra 4 have been spotty so far, multiple configurations are in and out of stock all priced at all-time lows – both the standard model and the higher-end version with the Milanese Loop are down nearly $100 right now.'}

{'text': '截稿前，其中一個亮點優惠為黑色鈦金屬Apple Watch Ultra 4配搭全新酒紅色Trail Loop（越野錶帶），減至699.99美元包郵，較原價低99美元。此外，米蘭尼斯錶帶配置同樣正下調至Prime Day價格。', 'en': 'As of writing, one standout deal has the black titanium Apple Watch Ultra 4 with the new wine red Trail Loop for $699.99 shipped, which is $99 off the regular price. The Milanese Loop config is also dropping to its Prime Day pricing right now.'}

  • {'text': '黑色Apple Watch Ultra 4配酒紅色Trail Loop 700美元（原價799美元）', 'en': 'Apple Watch Ultra 4 Black with Wine Red Trail Loop $700 ($799)'}
  • {'text': '原色Apple Watch Ultra 4配米蘭尼斯錶帶 800美元（原價899美元）', 'en': 'Apple Watch Ultra 4 Natural with Milanese Loop $800 ($899)'}

{'text': '除一貫的鋁金屬及鈦金屬Series 12之外，Apple亦推出全新、外觀極為優雅的陶瓷版Apple Watch Series 12。與傳統高級製錶世界的同類產品一樣，此版本定價較高，但隨着亞馬遜秋季Prime Day登場，我們剛開始見到首批顯著折扣。', 'en': "Beyond the usual aluminum and titanium Series 12 options, Apple is offering a new, extremely elegant ceramic variant of the Apple Watch Series 12. As with similar products in the traditional high-end watch world, it commands a higher price point, but as Amazon's fall Prime Day gets underway, we're starting to see the first notable discounts."}

{'text': 'Apple今年未有推出新一代入門級SE系列型號，但就以多款新錶帶選項為體驗帶來新意，而Prime Big Deal Days現正提供SE推出以來的首次現金折扣：', 'en': 'While Apple did not release a new entry-level SE model this year, it has refreshed the experience with a slew of new band options, and Prime Big Deal Days is offering the first cash discount on the SE yet:'}
